name: Rail Rat
behavior: Bites the lowest current-HP front-row member; its tell is a short crouch.

name: Clamp Beetle
behavior: Alternates a normal hit and one-action shell; attack another target during shell.

name: Quarry Wisp
behavior: Charges a small fire bolt; interruptible by any direct hit during its announced charge.

name: Ministry Hound
behavior: Marks one target before a lunge; cannot mark a fallen ally.

name: Canal Slime
behavior: Splits once below 50% HP; child has no further split and no extra rare loot.

name: Seal Drone
behavior: Applies short Silence, then a weak strike; cannot Silence the whole party at once.

name: Ledger Moth
behavior: Steals at most 10 temporary battle gold; all stolen gold returns on victory.

name: Patrol Shell
behavior: Guards the nearest ally for one action, then exposes its core.

name: Briar Wolf
behavior: Coordinated bite gains 10% if another wolf lives; capped at two wolves.

name: Root Mite
behavior: Applies Poison only after a one-action sap tell.

name: Pollen Bell
behavior: Sleep pollen affects one target and cannot be reapplied before that target acts.

name: Bog Lantern
behavior: Alternates water damage and a harmless lure animation that reveals its next target.

name: Rivet Imp
behavior: Throws a ranged rivet, then reloads for one opportunity.

name: Boiler Crab
behavior: Pressure grows for two actions, then a small area burst; cold reduces pressure.

name: Soot Sprite
behavior: Uses Blind, then weak shadow damage; healing items remain usable.

name: Furnace Hand
behavior: Raises a fist before a strong single-target strike; defense halves it.

name: Tide Page
behavior: Copies the element of the last incoming spell at reduced power.

name: Salt Leech
behavior: Drain heals only actual HP damage dealt.

name: Bell Diver
behavior: Alternates melee and a water spell; explicit undead tag permits hostile healing.

name: Archive Eye
behavior: Reveals and then targets the highest-MP ally; never drains more than 15 MP.

name: Chain Kite
behavior: Two light hits are one source action for counter limits.

name: Gust Viper
behavior: Dodges melee slightly; ranged and magical counters remain reliable.

name: Ballast Golem
behavior: High DEF, low RES; attacks slowly with a visible windup.

name: Sky Tick
behavior: Applies Slow to one target, then rests.

name: Ivory Sentinel
behavior: Alternates physical guard and magic guard, visibly changing sigils.

name: Seal Leech
behavior: Removes one party buff; never steals permanent learned abilities.

name: Frost Runner
behavior: Fast ice bite, low HP; no unavoidable opening burst.

name: Binding Hound
behavior: Brief one-target Stun; respects hard-control recovery protection.

name: Memory Shard
behavior: Echoes a normal Attack once, using its own stats.

name: Pale Singer
behavior: Heals one enemy at 50% power before repeating a weak light spell.

name: Glass Widow
behavior: Telegraphed Bleed; cleanse or switch to magic/Item to reduce its cost.

name: Absent Knight
behavior: Strong front-row melee; low accuracy and explicit undead affinity.

name: Crown Relay
behavior: Empowers one ally by 10%; duplicate relays do not stack buffs.

name: Ash Lancer
behavior: Charges for one full opportunity, then strikes a marked row.

name: Threshold Wisp
behavior: Fire spell followed by a self-exposing recovery period.

name: Edict Shell
behavior: Weaken seal on one target, then slow physical strike.

name: Broken Seraph
behavior: Warns before light area damage; physically fragile.

name: Cinder Automaton
behavior: Rotates defense and pressure without invulnerable phases.

name: Hollow Choirling
behavior: Schedules a two-action Doom warning; player has cleanse and damage options.

name: Crown Remnant
behavior: Cycles attack families to teach the final boss; no unique stolen keys.
